The squares pop up and flicker randomly. After a few moments of this texture glitching, the game completely freezes and crashes to the desktop with the notorious error: 

 "ERR_GFX_STATE: Game error. Please reboot and restart the game."

ModWorks is a desktop utility built to simplify the GTA V modding workflow.

 What it does
 ModWorks helps you work with common GTA V mod files and assets in one place. You can browse RPF archives more easily, work with textures, preview supported assets, manage archive contents, and use built-in utilities designed to speed up everyday modding tasks.

 Features
 - Browse RPF archives like normal folders
 - Preview models, textures, and AWC audio
 - Replace and export textures quickly
 - Batch swap texture dictionaries
 - Export textures to PNG or DDS
 - Vehicle modding utilities
 - Handling editing tools
 - YTD optimization tools
 - Built-in utilities such as cache clearing, KVP backups, crash analysis, and hash lookup

 Video Preview
 Watch the ModWorks showcase

 ModWorks is in its first public release. Some features may still have minor bugs or edge cases, but frequent updates and community feedback will continue to shape and improve the app. If you have suggestions or bug reports please let us know via our Discord (Link found below).
